title: A dense layer combines inputs
summary: A dense layer learns weights that combine input features. Here a layer with three units produces three values for each input row.
introduction: A dense layer learns weights that combine input features. Here a layer with three units produces three values for each input row. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain a dense layer combines inputs
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A dense layer learns weights that combine input features. Here a layer with three units produces three values for each input row.

blocks.code:
import tensorflow as tf

layer = tf.keras.layers.Dense(3)
x = tf.constant([[1.0, 2.0]])
print(tuple(layer(x).shape))
blocks.title: A dense layer combines inputs

blocks.text: The output shape is (1, 3): one row and three layer outputs. The initial output values depend on random weights.
